item.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.

item.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

item.title: DOJ accuses former cyber executive of defrauding ransomware victims by secretly paying hackers
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: U.S. prosecutors accused the former executive of defrauding victims of ransomware by paying the hackers, charging victims more, and pocketing the difference.

item.title: State AGs fight Character AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.

item.title: X’s latest update for creators focuses on vertical video
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: As short-form video ramps up in popularity, X's new creation tools are part of its effort to compete with YouTube and Instagram.

item.title: WhatsApp now lets you schedule messages in group and individual chats
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Users can schedule messages from 10 minutes later to after 14 days.

item.title: Allstate suffers multi-day tech outage ahead of Thanksgiving
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The disruption comes at a particularly bad time for the insurance giant, as millions of Americans prepare to travel for the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.

item.title: Todoist confirms 6% of customers’ details were stolen in data breach
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Todoist said a hacker gained access to its production systems and stole customer data, including email IDs, password hashes, and account creation dates.

item.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.

item.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down next week amid IPO uncertainty
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Flipkart's product and technology chief Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the company alongside its board until a successor is found.

item.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: The central question for investigators is what Nvidia knew about where those chips ended up and whether Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive gave the company reason to doubt Megaspeed's assurances.

item.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.

item.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.

item.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.

item.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.

item.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

item.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.

item.title: Maple raises $5.3M to build AI products that protect your data, even from itself
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The startup's encrypted AI architecture is designed to prevent even the company itself from accessing users' private data.

item.title: Dozens of oil and shipping tankers hacked in recent weeks, per report
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Iran is the chief suspect behind the dozens of cyberattacks targeting oil and chemical shipping vessels.

item.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.
